rationale: The description provides only broad data-platform, management, analytics, and deployment/performance claims without naming concrete data operations. Non_ai is the best binary choice from the text, but the broad claims do not meaningfully establish conventional functionality, so the negative is weak and forced.
evidence_spans: hybrid data platform designed for unmatched freedom to choose—any cloud, any analytics, any data
CDP delivers faster and easier data management and data analytics for data anywhere, with optimal performance, scalability, and security.
conflict_response: The concern correctly notes that the description supplies platform categories and benefits rather than specific operations. Those words do not establish AI, but neither do they sufficiently support a conventional-function negative under the rubric; I retain non_ai as the best binary judgment and mark it weak/forced instead of treating absence of an AI claim as support.
